splitByNameOption: Split .fla to small projects according to .sc export names
groupsOption: An array of user-defined regular expressions to split .fla into project groups
groupsOption_details:
An array of user-defined regular expressions to split .fla into project groups
Example, this command will export all export names starting with "bgr": 
`n!sc2fla file.sc .group=^bgr.*`
You can also use multiple expressions, but you need to specify group name then, for example: 
`n!sc2fla file.sc .group=background:^bgr.* .group=character:^char.*`'''
as3DocOption: Creates an ActionScript document for the .fla project
as3DocOption_details: Creates an ActionScript document for the .fla project, instead of the SupercellSWF document, for cases where the SupercellSWF plugin is not available
